bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears defeated the Atlanta Falcons 31-23 on Sunday as quarterback Caleb Williams completed his first 12 passes in his return from a hamstring injury, while D'Andre Swift ran for two touchdowns . The win improved Chicago to 4-2, and cornerback Kyler Gordon recorded 3 sacks in his return from injury as the Bears now prepare for a quick turnaround to host the New England Patriots on Thursday night at Soldier Field.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are using their Week 6 bye to address roster and health issues, having placed three players on injured reserve while anticipating safety Brian Branch's return to practice, as he says, "I'm ready to go." Looking ahead, the Lions are preparing for a Week 7 matchup against Green Bay, with reports noting that Josh Jacobs's return gives the Packers another dimension that worries the Lions heading into that game.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers defeated the Dallas Cowboys 23-13 in Sunday Night Football, marking their third straight win, with quarterback Jordan Love throwing for 290 yards and two touchdowns while also scoring his first rushing touchdown since November 2024. Packers shut down Cowboys for third straight win, with Christian Watson catching three of eight targets for 64 yards while playing second fiddle to Matthew Golden, who led the receiving corps.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: Former Vikings wide receiver Cordarrelle Patterson, a seven-time All-Pro who began his career with Minnesota as a 2013 first-round pick, was arrested on Saturday morning in Tennessee and reportedly booked on a charge of domestic assault . The news comes as the 5-0 Vikings enjoy their bye week, with the team hopeful that running back Jordan Mason can return from injured reserve for their Week 7 game versus the Colts after recovering from thumb surgery.
